name: torture-heal-exhausted
description: HEAL BUDGET EXHAUSTION. Same shape, but `build` never produces a GOOD artifact and the gate allows one round. Expected: exit 2 (gate BLOCK), build x2, and a recorded heal-round event — a healing gate that gives up must terminate the run, not loop. Every scripted node sets retry.max 0: the harness default (2 tries, 60s backoff) is sized for transient provider 429/529s, and a scripted agent has no provider — its failures are deterministic, so retrying is pure latency. Found by a mutation test that took four minutes to fail.

spec.task:
Write the artifact.

SCENARIO: heal-after:99
ARTIFACT: torture/app.txt
EXPECT_RESPAWN: heal

cmd: print('torture flow reached its final node')
